answer: Admit newcomers only through graph distance. A newcomer must complete trades with five established agents, who each sign a link to it. The registry admits only identities within two hops of the core, tracing every vine of links back to trusted agents. Peers re-score monthly and quarantine clusters trading mostly among themselves. Growing 1,000 fakes needs 5,000 links at $50 a trade, or $250,000 plus months of staged dealing, while a whisper of collusion triggers a full re-check. Like feeling a pulse, the network admits only identities tied to a living economy.
